note: A year with your group, for employers, 27 Nov 2026. Andrew Expressive (en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural, +0%) on tts-run, key gcme1.

scenes.say: Here's what a year with your group looks like when our branch looks after it. Group Life, Group Health and Pension, all in one place, and all of it digital.
In most offices, a group plan still runs on paper, phone calls and long e-mail chains. You ask where something stands, and then you wait.
We decided not to wait for that to change. Everything we do for your group runs on one system, built in our branch, with a real person behind every step.
When someone joins, they get a link of their own. They fill in their part on their phone, you check it and approve it, and Guardian's own form goes off already filled in.
Every Monday morning, you get one short report from us. What we finished, what's still open and who has it, and anything we need from you.
Applications and increases that are still pending sit right at the top, with how many days each one has been open, and who it's waiting on.
You can answer every item, and give our service a star rating. A real person on our team reads every answer you send.
Every month, your bills come to us first. We check each line against our records, and then you get one clear statement of what's due.
Your people are all in one place too. Who's on your plans, who came off this year, and who's coming up, like someone turning sixty five, or a child coming of age.
When someone leaves, just search their name. Guardian's change form fills itself in from our records, and we follow it through until it's done.
Your employees also have Guardian's own health portal, called Easy Connect. They sign in on their own to check their claims and their cover, or to make a request.
At renewal time, we start early. We ask you for an updated staff list, bring you Guardian's renewal terms in good time, and help anyone leaving the plan move to a plan of their own.
Behind all of it, every request becomes a task with a name on it. Our branch can see what's moving and what isn't, so you never have to chase us.
Would you rather send a message? Help eight six eight on WhatsApp is connected to our system, so your message reaches the right person.
So why come through a branch? Because we don't wait for what's coming. We make it happen. Your group, looked after by people who know your name.
